constraints: Amazon Linux 2023 is a separate major release: rebuild the host rather than upgrading in place.
Confirm installed packages and agents are available for Amazon Linux 2023 before switching.

steps.instructions: Launch a replacement host on Amazon Linux 2023 from the same configuration, then move traffic to it.
steps.title: Replace the Amazon Linux host

verification.purpose: Confirm the host reports Amazon Linux 2023.
Check that package updates resolve on the new host.

rules.summary: Amazon Linux 2 reached the end of standard support on 2026-06-30, and Amazon Linux AMI 2018.03 ended support on 2023-12-31. Amazon Linux 2023 is supported until 2029-06-30.
rules.title: Amazon Linux 2 and the 2018.03 AMI are past end of support
